## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] `npm run e2e` passes, if a screen or a flow changed
- [ ] New behaviour has a test
- [ ] New text is in every language in `src/i18n/locales`
- [ ] No new health claim, or the source was agreed in an issue and is in `docs/EVIDENCE.md`
- [ ] Nothing leaves the device (no network calls, no analytics, no remote assets)
